name: Feature Vector Construction for Multi-Channel Transfer Functions
definition: A feature vector is constructed for each voxel to encode areas of interest in multi-channel data, enabling the use of dimensionality reduction algorithms to create a low-dimensional transfer function domain.
summary: Feature vector construction for multi-channel transfer functions generates high-dimensional voxel signatures encoding intensity, gradient, and statistics to capture multi-channel correlations, defining the explicit feature space for dimensionality reduction rather than the reduction algorithm itself.
